segments.text: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Nicodemus
segments.text: Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
Jesus answered and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

segments.speaker: Nicodemus
segments.text: Nicodemus saith unto him,
How can a man be born when he is old?

segments.speaker: Nicodemus
segments.text: can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?
Jesus answered,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

segments.speaker: Nicodemus
segments.text: Nicodemus answered and said unto him,
How can these things be?
Jesus answered and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
¶ After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
¶ And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
For John was not yet cast into prison.
¶ Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.
And they came unto John, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: John's Disciples
segments.text: Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
John answered and said,

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: He must increase, but I must decrease.

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

segments.speaker: John
segments.text: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
